description: Returns the songs and prayers inside Scripture (the Song of the Sea, Hannah's prayer, the Magnificat…), each with its name, Hebrew title, kind (victory, prophetic, thanksgiving, boast, prayer, work song, blessing, lament or hymn), passage reference and link. kind narrows the list; otherwise the whole list comes back in one piece. Use when the user asks which songs and prayers appear inside Scripture, such as the Song of the Sea or the Magnificat.

kind.description: kind of song or prayer, e.g. victory, lament, prayer, blessing, hymn, thanksgiving

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: list_songs
title: Songs and prayers in Scripture
